input.quote: (a) At any time that there is no uncompleted Statement of Work outstanding, either party may terminate this Agreement for any or no reason upon fifteen (15) days advance notice to the other.
input.rationale: The term is open-ended (§ 2: continues until terminated under § 6), so this is effectively a term longer than 12 months. The only convenience right in § 6(a) is available solely when no Statement of Work is outstanding, so Company has no right to exit an in-flight engagement for convenience and no refund of prepaid fees — the missing-behaviour deviation contemplated by the rule. Conversely, Contractor may walk on 15 days' notice, far below the 90-day floor. The redline adds a Company 30-day convenience right over the Agreement or any SOW with a refund of prepaid amounts, and restricts Contractor's convenience right to 90 days' notice between Statements of Work.

proposal.summary: Give Company a 30-day convenience right (including mid-SOW) with refund of prepaid fees, and limit Contractor's convenience right to 90 days' notice when no SOW is outstanding.
proposal.comment: [Playbook] We have added a Company right to terminate the Agreement or any Statement of Work for convenience on 30 days' notice with a refund of prepaid fees, since as drafted we cannot exit while any Statement of Work is outstanding even though the term is open-ended. We have also moved Contractor's convenience right to 90 days' notice and only between Statements of Work so Contractor cannot walk away mid-engagement; if helpful, we can discuss 60 days for our notice period.

ops.oldText: (a) At any time that there is no uncompleted Statement of Work outstanding, either party may terminate this Agreement for any or no reason upon fifteen (15) days advance notice to the other.
ops.newText: (a) Company may terminate this Agreement or any Statement of Work, in whole or in part, for any or no reason upon thirty (30) days advance written notice to Contractor, in which case Contractor shall refund any prepaid fees for the period after the effective date of termination and Company shall have no further liability other than for Services performed through the effective date of termination. At any time that there is no uncompleted Statement of Work outstanding, Contractor may terminate this Agreement for any or no reason upon ninety (90) days advance written notice to Company.
